thoughts: The request names one game and two things it must feel like.
text: Rewording the request into a game brief; not designing anything.
log: prompt: brief — Concept: a fast arcade snake on a neon grid, one screen, keyboard only. Requested features: wrap-around walls, a speed ramp, chunky trail glow. Constraints: desktop browser, no assets. Acceptance: it boots to a title screen, plays, ends, and restarts without a reload.
